title: Hanover Park (Suria Walk, approx.): man, 37, shot dead, 15 Oct
summary: A 37-year-old man was shot dead in Suria Walk, Hanover Park, at about 06:05 on Thursday 15 October; police say the motive is believed to be gang-related (Daily Voice). The article's text misprints the year as 2006; its d...
story: A 37-year-old man was shot dead in Suria Walk, Hanover Park, at about 06:05 on Thursday 15 October; police say the motive is believed to be gang-related (Daily Voice). The article's text misprints the year as 2006; its date and the police details give 15 October 2026.
location_note: Suria Walk, Hanover Park (exact spot not given). The pin is on the walkway.

provenance.note: One report. The police statement, plus an unnamed resident.

sources.name: Captain F.C. van Wyk, SAPS
sources.quote: in which a 37-year-old male was shot and fatally wounded.

facts.label: Date and time
facts.detail: Outlet opening says Thursday, 15 October 2006; police say this morning in 15 October 2026 article. Source inconsistency retained, not deleted.
